+"""Chair sitting controller for the rcb-limited H1 service."""
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+def normalize(q, joint_range):
+    return np.clip((2 * q - joint_range[:, 0] - joint_range[:, 1]) /
+                   (joint_range[:, 1] - joint_range[:, 0]), -1, 1)
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    observed = robot.observe(images=False)
+    if observed["step"] != 0 or observed["done"]:
+        observed = robot.reset(images=False)
+
+    joint_range = np.asarray(robot.spec()["qpos"]["range"], dtype=float)
+    initial = np.asarray(observed["proprio"]["joint_pos"], dtype=float)
+    approach = normalize(initial, joint_range)
+    seated = initial.copy()
+    seated[[2, 7]] = -1.5
+    seated[[3, 8]] = 1.75
+    seated[[4, 9]] = -0.3
+    sit_action = normalize(seated, joint_range)
+
+    while not observed["done"]:
+        start = observed["step"]
+        count = min(10, 1000 - start)
+        if count <= 0:
+            break
+        actions = [approach if start + j < 55 else sit_action
+                   for j in range(count)]
+        observed = robot.step("qpos", actions, images=False)
+
+    print({k: observed[k] for k in ("step", "done", "reason", "resets_left")})
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch"));
